question: 5 nearest populated places to Helsinki Vantaa, km
sql: WITH hub AS (SELECT geometry FROM airports WHERE name='Helsinki Vantaa' ORDER BY iata_code LIMIT 1) SELECT p.name, p.country, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, hub.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM populated_places p CROSS JOIN hub ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, hub.geometry), p.name, p.country LIMIT 5

question: airports within 500 km of Abu Dhabi, nearest first, top 10
sql: WITH ref AS (SELECT geometry FROM populated_places WHERE name='Abu Dhabi' AND country='United Arab Emirates' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1) SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, a.type, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, ref.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM airports a CROSS JOIN ref WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, ref.geometry) <= 500000 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, ref.geometry), a.name, a.iata_code LIMIT 10

question: nearest airport to Los Angeles, Kirov, Maiduguri
sql: SELECT p.name AS place, nearest.name AS airport, nearest.iata_code, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(nearest.geometry, p.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM populated_places p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, a.geometry FROM airports a ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, p.geometry), a.name, a.iata_code LIMIT 1) nearest WHERE (p.name='Los Angeles' AND p.country='United States of America') OR (p.name='Kirov' AND p.country='Russia') OR (p.name='Maiduguri' AND p.country='Nigeria') ORDER BY p.name, p.country

question: airports within 1000 km of both Los Angeles and Flagstaff, nearest to Los Angeles first
sql: WITH la AS (SELECT geometry FROM populated_places WHERE name='Los Angeles' AND country='United States of America' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1), fl AS (SELECT geometry FROM populated_places WHERE name='Flagstaff' AND country='United States of America' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1) SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, la.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS dist_la_km, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, fl.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS dist_flag_km FROM airports a CROSS JOIN la CROSS JOIN fl WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, la.geometry) <= 1000000 AND ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, fl.geometry) <= 1000000 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, la.geometry), a.name, a.iata_code LIMIT 15

question: nearest populated place to each spaceport airport, km
sql: SELECT a.name AS airport, a.iata_code, nearest.name AS place, nearest.country, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(nearest.geometry, a.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM airports a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.name, p.country, p.geometry FROM populated_places p ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, a.geometry), p.name, p.country LIMIT 1) nearest WHERE a.type='spaceport' ORDER BY a.name, a.iata_code

question: cities over 1M within 300 km of Vadodara airport, nearest first
sql: WITH ref AS (SELECT geometry FROM airports WHERE name='Vadodara' ORDER BY iata_code LIMIT 1) SELECT p.name, p.country, p.pop_max, ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, ref.geometry)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM populated_places p CROSS JOIN ref WHERE p.pop_max > 1000000 AND ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, ref.geometry) <= 300000 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, ref.geometry), p.name, p.country LIMIT 20
